entry_state: Chapter 4 is complete through physical 79. Accounting algebra separates conserved balances from permitted transactions; dynamic models motivate economic and behavioural state without supplying universal defaults. Shared unknowns and conditional tables preserve joint incomplete information; scoped certainty, provenance and public availability are distinct from posterior probability. Priors, model averaging and interventions add assumptions, and duplicate encodings must not gain mass. A typed library competes with a DSL; rule conflicts, supported alternatives and stochastic uncertainty differ. Table structure, PDF text assignment and financial meaning have separate evaluation targets; cropped-table TEDS and QA answers cannot establish whole-company accuracy. Solvers are bounded and inference remains optional. The synthesis hands the unresolved integration chain to Chapter 5 without claiming originality, empirical advantage or complete source coverage.
exit_state: Chapter 5 is complete: one typed IR connects evidence, compatible histories, scenarios and reports; a DSL remains a reversible frontend and imported tools do not acquire accounting authority. Source inspection and licence labels do not establish integration, performance or distribution clearance. Chapter 6 begins by defining observations, contexts, cutoff and model scope before the joint compatibility family. Empty or singleton feasibility has only scoped meaning. The complete two-history A/B payable example separates complete query answers, optional certain-row intersection and Boolean certainty: each history owes 100, no creditor row is certain, and a union is not a complete schedule. Query conditions and producing histories survive; no probability, universal real-world completeness or guaranteed finite relational representation follows. The next pages must carry these alternatives into coupled dynamics and conditional results.
findings: Physical 80–85 were actually rendered and viewed in order before the session handoff; these are the retained specific observations, now recorded without reinitialising the inventory.
